title.zh: 微软发布AI医疗诊断工具，称其诊断准确率优于医生
title.en: Microsoft unveils AI diagnostic tool claimed to outperform doctors

current_state.zh: 一项《科学》研究发现，微软的新AI诊断系统在疑难病例上胜过全科医生，不过大部分提升被归因于底层AI模型，而非微软系统本身。
current_state.en: A Science study found Microsoft's new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on difficult medical cases, though most of the improvement was attributed to the underlying AI models rather than Microsoft's system itself.

updates.title_zh: 微软称其AI工具在诊断疾病方面优于医生
updates.title_en: Microsoft says its AI tool is better than doctors at diagnosing conditions
updates.what_changed_zh:
微软AI部门首席执行官穆斯塔法·苏莱曼宣布推出一款新的AI诊断系统，公司称其在诊断疾病方面比人类医生的准确率最高可达四倍。该说法基于2026年10月22日发表在《Science》上的同行评审研究。

该结果发表在同行评审期刊而非公司演示中，使微软的说法比一般产品发布更具分量。不过，对照对象是在疑难病例上的一般内科医生，而非专科医生。

微软该系统被称为“诊断编排器”（MAI-DxO），在《Science》研究中报告的准确率为83.2%。相关报道指出，性能提升的很大一部分似乎来自底层AI模型，而非微软的系统本身。
updates.what_changed_en: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman announced a new AI diagnostic tool that the company claims can diagnose medical conditions up to four times more accurately than human doctors.

updates.current_state_en: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman announced a new AI diagnostic tool that the company claims can diagnose medical conditions up to four times more accurately than human doctors.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman announced a new AI diagnostic tool that the company claims can diagnose medical conditions up to four times more accurately than human doctors.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman announced a new AI diagnostic tool that the company claims can diagnose medical conditions up to four times more accurately than human doctors.
updates.background_zh: AI公司长期将医疗健康视为其技术的旗舰应用场景，苏莱曼也公开将这项工作描述为迈向其所称“医疗超级智能”的努力。此前的研究普遍发现，生成式AI的诊断表现与非专家级医生相当，但低于专家级的可靠性水平。
updates.background_en: AI companies have long pitched healthcare as a flagship use case for their technology, and Suleyman has publicly framed the work as a push toward what he calls medical superintelligence. Earlier research has generally found generative AI diagnostic performance comparable to non-expert physicians but below expert-level reliability.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此事对加密市场没有直接的传导路径：该发布涉及的是一套临床诊断系统，不包含代币、托管或链上组件。若有影响也只可能是间接的，通过AI板块的整体情绪传导，而AI概念代币有时会跟随这一情绪。
updates.market_impact_en: There is no direct transmission path to crypto markets: the announcement concerns a clinical diagnostic system with no token, custody, or on-chain component. Any effect would be indirect, via general AI-sector sentiment that AI-branded tokens sometimes track.
